summary: No critical EOS implementation defect was found in the reviewed diff. The canonical-only UI/backend behavior, one-time migration mapping, rollback safety, and collector timestamp fix match the accepted RFC scope based on code inspection and recorded verification evidence. Shipping is not approved because a required migration history check remains red, and the disposable migration verifier is still missing some RFC-required operator diagnostics.

major.title: Required phase3 migration history check remains red
evidence: rfcs/0016-eos-canonical-parameters/jsons/verification.json records `bash bin/verify-phase3-migrations.sh` with exit_code 1: assistant-api reaches clean61 and web-api expected12 differs from actual13.
bin/verify-phase3-migrations.sh:470-473 verifies assistant-api at 61 but still verifies web-api at 12.
api/web-api/migrations currently contains 13 `*.up.sql` files and ends with `000013_create_product_usages.up.sql`.
major.impact: A required check is failing, so this review cannot approve shipping even though the failure is not introduced by the EOS canonical parameter implementation.
major.required_resolution: Record the already requested user approval or make the separate web-api expectation correction outside this review scope before shipping approval.

minor.title: Disposable migration verifier does not emit all RFC-required operator diagnostics
evidence: rfcs/0016-eos-canonical-parameters.md:284-292 requires target row counts by provider, changed row counts, deleted obsolete key counts, invalid candidate report, journal row counts, clean version 61, and post-migration target alias count zero.

bin/verify-eos-options-migration.sh:33-39 runs the disposable database migration/tests and verifies clean schema version 61, then prints a single pass message without surfacing provider counts, deletion counts, journal counts, invalid candidate details, or post-migration alias-zero counts.
minor.impact: The SQL behavior is covered by tests, but the operational evidence available during an environment-specific run is thinner than the accepted RFC's diagnostics contract.
minor.recommended_resolution: Extend the existing script with direct SELECT diagnostics and assertions using its current disposable database, without adding a new generic helper.
